test_cython_api_partial_response_read: test the cygrpc Cython API corner case where a client reads some but not all server responses before cancelling
run_ServerDriver_completion_queue_pollin: run the _ServerDriver class to poll a cygrpc CompletionQueue in a background thread and collect events until a shutdown tag
run_QueueDriver_tagged_event_collection: run the _QueueDriver class to poll a CompletionQueue and collect events matching a set of expected tags
review_segregated_call_client_server_bat: review the cygrpc segregated_call and start_server_batch API for sending and receiving messages with tagged operations
test_client_call_cancel_partial_read: test cancelling a cygrpc client call mid-stream after reading only the first server message
